test_factorize_categorical: test pd.factorize on a Categorical array and verify returned codes and unique values
test_factorize_sorted: test pd.factorize with sort=True on a Categorical array and verify sorted unique values
test_factorize_ordered: test pd.factorize with sort=True on an ordered Categorical and verify category order is preserved
test_isin_categorical: test Categorical.isin for membership checks including NaN and empty inputs
test_diff_categorical_raises: test that calling diff on a categorical Series raises TypeError
test_hash_categorical_dtype: test hashing a CategoricalDtype created from an Index values array
